title: Kiln ROCm Hugging Face Next-Token Oracle Result v2
description: Result of one independent eager Hugging Face next-token comparison on ROCm. The record binds the pushed source tree, implementation bytes, request, model, process containment, full-vocabulary logits artifact, and verdict; it attributes this exact divergent state rather than proving general model parity.

schema.description: Schema identifier for this oracle-result format.

result_sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 identity of the complete result after removing this self-hash field.

created_at_utc.description: UTC time when the result record was created.

duration_seconds.description: Total wall-clock duration of model fingerprinting, contained oracle execution, verification, and result assembly.

source.description: Clean pushed repository identity used to build and execute the oracle.

commit.description: Full Git commit checked out during execution.

origin_main.description: Full `origin/main` commit required to equal the checked-out commit.

tree.description: Git tree object for the checked-out commit.

implementation.description: Content identities of the worker, interpreter, and containment runner that produced the oracle evidence.

hf_worker_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the eager Hugging Face logits worker.

python_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the Python executable used for fingerprinting and oracle execution.

process_runner_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the process-containment runner.

request.description: Repository-local attribution request, its canonical identity, and the paired candidate-source receipts it binds.

contract_path.description: Repository-relative path to the retained Hugging Face next-token request.

id.description: Request identifier copied from the retained contract.

sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 identity of the retained request content.

source.description: Source revision and Kiln/vLLM qualification receipts copied from the request.

model_identity.description: Recomputed content identity of the exact model, tokenizer, chat template, configuration, and weight shards.

model_fingerprint.description: Implementation and process evidence for the separate contained model-fingerprinting step.

containment.description: Host-memory preflight, network isolation, and process-exit evidence for the oracle worker.

host_available_before_gib.description: Whole GiB of host memory reported available immediately before contained oracle launch.

network.description: Network policy applied to the systemd service; fixed to a private network namespace with access forbidden.

service.description: Bounded process evidence for the contained oracle service.

oracle.description: Full-vocabulary Hugging Face output, candidate ranks, runtime identity, and resource evidence for the bound input state.

reference_artifact.description: Ignored local safetensors file retaining the complete full-vocabulary logits used by later attribution work.

bytes.description: Exact size of the retained logits artifact in bytes.

location.description: Retention class; `local_ignored` means the artifact is intentionally outside tracked source.

sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the retained logits artifact's exact bytes.

verdict.description: Attribution of the Hugging Face argmax to one disputed candidate, or to neither candidate.

argmax_candidate.description: Candidate engine whose token uniquely equals the Hugging Face argmax; `neither` also covers no match or an ambiguous duplicate.

argmax_token_id.description: Hugging Face full-vocabulary argmax token ID.

candidate_attribution_complete.description: True only when exactly one of the Kiln or vLLM candidate tokens matches the Hugging Face argmax.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest with the `sha256:` algorithm prefix.

gitObject.description: Full lowercase SHA-1 Git object identifier.

tokenId.description: Tokenizer vocabulary ID for the bound Qwen3.5-4B model identity.

receiptReference.description: Repository-relative qualification receipt with hashes of both its file bytes and canonical content.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the retained receipt.

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the receipt file's exact bytes.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the receipt's canonical content.

sourcePair.description: Source revision and qualification receipts for the Kiln and vLLM candidate-producing runs.

source_commit.description: Full Git commit shared by the paired candidate runs.

kiln_receipt.description: Retained Kiln qualification receipt and its content identities.

vllm_receipt.description: Retained vLLM qualification receipt and its content identities.

weightFile.description: One model weight shard and its exact size and content identity.

path.description: Path or stable shard name within the bound model source.

sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the shard's exact bytes.

modelIdentity.description: Complete content identity for the model inputs used by candidate and oracle processes.

id.description: Human-readable model identifier recorded alongside the content hashes.

content_sha256.description: Aggregate content identity for the complete model source.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 identity of the effective model configuration.

tokenizer_hash.description: SHA-256 identity of the tokenizer inputs.

chat_template_hash.description: SHA-256 identity of the chat template used to render the prompt.

weight_files.description: Complete ordered inventory of model weight shards.

modelFingerprintEvidence.description: Source identity and bounded process evidence for the separate model-provenance hashing process.

implementation_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the model-fingerprint implementation.

python_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the Python executable used for fingerprinting.

process.description: Bounded process evidence for the separate fingerprint worker.

topToken.description: One of the ten highest Hugging Face logits, ordered from highest to lowest.

token_id.description: Vocabulary ID of this ranked token.

logit.description: F32 logit produced by the eager Hugging Face reference.

candidateToken.description: One disputed engine candidate with its Hugging Face logit and one-based full-vocabulary rank.

token_id.description: Vocabulary ID predicted by the named engine.

text.description: Tokenizer-decoded text for the predicted token.

logit.description: Hugging Face logit at this candidate's vocabulary ID.

rank.description: One-based rank of this candidate in the complete Hugging Face vocabulary, with 1 denoting the argmax.

oracleEvidence.description: Eager Hugging Face next-token evidence for one exact request and model state.

attention_implementation.description: Transformers full-attention implementation selected for the oracle; fixed to eager execution.

argmax.description: Vocabulary ID with the highest Hugging Face logit.

argmax_text.description: Tokenizer-decoded text for the Hugging Face argmax token.

candidate_tokens.description: The two disputed candidates, ordered as Kiln then vLLM, annotated with their Hugging Face logits and ranks.

engine.description: The first candidate must come from Kiln.
The second candidate must come from vLLM.

configuration_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the fixed oracle execution configuration enforced by the worker.

deterministic_algorithms.description: Whether PyTorch deterministic algorithms were required; fixed to true.

device.description: Diagnostic accelerator name reported by PyTorch. It identifies this run but is not a dispatch-policy input.

dtype.description: Model execution dtype used by the oracle.

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock duration of the eager Hugging Face worker itself.

input_token_count.description: Number of tokens in the complete prompt-plus-continuation input.

input_token_ids_sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 identity of the complete input-token sequence.

linear_attention_implementation.description: Transformers implementation selected for Gated DeltaNet linear-attention layers.

logits_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the contiguous F32 full-vocabulary logit bytes after the bound continuation state.

memory_high_events.description: Number of cgroup `memory.events` high-threshold events observed during the contained worker.

memory_oom_events.description: Number of cgroup out-of-memory events observed during the contained worker.

memory_oom_kill_events.description: Number of cgroup out-of-memory kill events observed during the contained worker.

memory_peak_bytes.description: Peak cgroup memory consumption in bytes during the contained worker.

memory_swap_bytes.description: Cgroup swap usage in bytes reported for the contained worker.

modeling_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the pinned Transformers Qwen3.5 modeling implementation expected by the worker.

output_bytes.description: Exact size in bytes of the retained full-vocabulary logits artifact.

request_id.description: Identifier copied from the bound next-token request.

request_sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 identity of the bound next-token request.

tf32_allowed.description: Whether TF32 matrix operations were permitted; fixed to false for this comparison.

top_logit_margin.description: Positive difference between the highest and second-highest Hugging Face logits.

top_tokens.description: Exactly the ten highest Hugging Face tokens and logits, ordered from highest to lowest.

torch_commit.description: Pinned PyTorch source commit used by the qualification environment.

torch_hip_version.description: HIP runtime version reported by the pinned PyTorch build.

processEvidence.description: Bounded worker execution record emitted by the shared process-containment runner.

elapsed_seconds.description: Wall-clock duration observed by the containment runner.

schema.description: Schema identifier for the shared process-containment evidence.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum worker duration enforced by the containment runner.

worker_exit_code.description: Contained worker exit code; zero is required for retained oracle evidence.
